en: A vintage black‑and‑white view of a wide tree‑lined boulevard with tram tracks running down the center. Low buildings with balconies and flags line the left side, pedestrians and a few riders are visible along the street, and bare trees suggest winter. Printed captions in Greek and French identify the location as a boulevard in Thessaloniki (Salonique). The overall style and printing indicate an early 20th‑century postcard.
